extracted.name: Zucchini Tomato Pie
extracted.description: Zucchini, tomato, and onion combine with Parmesan cheese and baking mix, like Bisquick, to make this pie recipe a snap to throw together on a summer day.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Coat a 10-inch pie plate with cooking spray.
Combine zucchini, tomato, onion, and Parmesan cheese in the prepared pie plate.
Beat baking mix, eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl until smooth; pour over zucchini mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until a knife inserted into center comes out clean, about 30 minutes.
